{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''ANGDA Glennallen to Palmer Spur Line''' is a shelved natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.arlis.org/docs/vol1/AlaskaGas/Legal/Legal_ANGDA_2005_RightWayLeaseAppGlennallen.pdf|title=arlis.org|website=arlis.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Glennallen, Alaska to Palmer, Alaska.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.arlis.org/docs/vol1/AlaskaGas/Legal/Legal_ANGDA_2005_RightWayLeaseAppGlennallen.pdf|title=arlis.org|website=arlis.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
